experiment: same MMS on current and vessel-fitted grids, before/after PR392
interpretation: Coarse fitted grid worsens multiplier error; globally refining the fitted generator once improves it.
Cells and solid DoFs differ: this is not an equal-cost comparison. All matched cases finish with 16 flow cells and 32 DG1 multiplier DoFs.
PR392 changes only documentation/comments: all exported fields are identical in each matched before/after pair, at export precision. Remove fictitious modal response remains true in all cases.

The fitted wall has vertices on the circle but piecewise flat Q1 faces. Initial polygonal vessel-volume errors are -9.9684% and -2.55046%; these differ from sampled modal-volume and added-volume defects.
Tolerance relaxation remains material for area/added volume; no temporal-error bound or asymptotic spatial order is claimed.
Elapsed times overlap builds/other runs and are not scaling measurements.
The two initial preflight failures used removed parameter aliases and failed before time integration; canonical names were then used with unchanged values.
